recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a woman with voluminous dark hair, wearing a crisp white high-collared shirt, set against a mottled brown textured background. The composition features a dominant, expressive script title at the top and a smaller sans-serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the sharp white shirt and the earthy, textured backdrop
Integration of the script lettering into the subject's hair volume
Balance between the large expressive script and the tiny geometric subtitle
Soft facial lighting contrasting with the rough texture of the background
coreInvariants: Large-scale script typography spanning the top third
Direct eye contact with a soft smile

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills the lower two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large white script at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large script, move down to the face, then to the subtitle, and finally to the bright white collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the textured background surrounding the head provide breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and tans in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white in the shirt and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and pink tones in the makeup and lips.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white elements and the mid-tone background; low saturation overall except for skin warmth.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to natural earth tones and stark white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a brush-stroke feel
letterConstructionRules: Rough, textured edges suggesting a dry brush or chalk
Connected lowercase letters with long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
Uppercase letters are significantly larger and more expressive
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'B' have large, open loops
The 't' crossbar extends far to the right

composition.position: Below the end of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, textured script paired with a clean, minimal geometric sans-serif for legibility.

preserve: The dry-brush texture of the main script
The high-collar framing of the face

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, thin-stroke subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with big 80s-style dark curly hair, wearing a white poplin shirt with a large popped collar. The background is a mottled, textured brown and tan studio backdrop. Soft, warm lighting on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, hand-drawn dry-brush script title across the top, slightly overlapping the hair. Below the right side of the title, add a small, thin geometric sans-serif subtitle in white.

verificationChecks: Is the main title textured like a dry brush?
Is the background mottled and earthy?
Is the collar of the shirt prominent and white?
Is the subtitle significantly smaller than the main title?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Tactile, non-digital quality to the script lettering
Balanced composition between text and portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'chalky' edges on the large script
Ensure the white shirt doesn't blow out facial details
Verify the background has a painterly, non-uniform texture
Confirm the subtitle is legible but secondary
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-volume hair portrait with a textured studio backdrop and top-aligned expressive brush script for a classic soul/R&B aesthetic.
